campaign_name: Constitution Progress and Benchmark Governance Amendment
purpose: Adopt the progress, failure, and benchmark governance amendments inside the existing Constitution, review handoff, validation evidence standard, and Product Realization validation rules. No gameplay change and no benchmark corpus.
executive_summary: Implementation outcome: the approved amendments are in the Constitution and the three specialized standards, with the refinements recorded in the adoption report. Failure classes are provisional and are not the replay taxonomy. Original reproduction: not applicable; this pass repairs no gameplay failure. Related generalization: not applicable. Independent generalization: not evaluated. Regression: no production or test code changed; the documentation review found no conflict with playability scoring or replay classification. ATGB: no result, because no reviewed corpus exists. Known limitations: the benchmark cannot be run or claimed yet. Remaining uncertainty: docs/NEXT_SESSION.md still orients the product at the 2026-09-26 PR-BL closeout, while later PR-EG history remains in handoff history. That discrepancy is pending maintenance and was not reconciled. No gameplay improvement is claimed.
